newsitem.title: USA: Questron files for 1997 share offering.
newsitem.headline: Questron files for 1997 share offering.

text.p: Questron Technology Inc said Friday it had signed an agreement to acquire Comp Ware Inc d/b/a Webb Distribution, a distributor of fasteners and electronic hardware in the New England market with annual sales of about $8 million.
The company also said it had filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission proposing a public offering in early 1997 to generate about $6 million.
The offering would consist of newly issued shares of the company's Series B Convertible Preferred Stock and warrants to purchase shares of common stock, it said.

Questron said it would use the money earned from the offering to fund the cash portion of the purchase price to acquire Webb, as well as to pay off Webb's debt and a portion of the company's own debt.

Under the terms of the acquisition, Questron said it would pay $3.3 million in cash, a portion of which would come from the proposed offering, $750,000 in notes, as well as newly- issued securities of the company.
Webb had total assets, principally consisting of accounts receivable and inventory, of $3.2 million on September 30, 1996.
